readings: For each nearby corporate event type (`corpeventprx`) in the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots, with snapshots that have no event type as their own group, show the event type, the average number of analyst coverage reports (`anlycount`), and the average of insider ownership minus institutional ownership (`inholdpct` − `instownpct`). Keep the sign of that difference, so it is negative when institutional ownership is higher. Also show the event type's average difference minus the plain average of all the event types' average differences; this last value can be negative. Averages ignore missing values. Return nothing if that overall average is missing, and don't round anything.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT corpeventprx,
         AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
         AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_diff
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_avg FROM g
)
SELECT g.corpeventprx,
       g.avg_anlycount,
       g.avg_diff,
       g.avg_diff - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall
FROM g, o
WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;
